name: Saber
text: A marshal's saber and a round shield.

name: Pistol
text: A Columbia service pistol: six rounds, fast, loud.

name: Musket
text: A long Columbia musket: two rounds, and it does not miss twice.

name: Harpoon
text: A river harpoon on a line, for things that live under barges.

name: Boat-hook
text: A pilot's boat-hook: pull the thing close, then decide.

name: Oar-staff
text: An ironwood oar-staff, heavy at both ends.

name: Air-pistol
text: A compressed-air pistol from the dock-yards. Quiet.

name: Rapier
text: A Lunden rapier: quick, narrow, and polite until it is not.

name: Grapple
text: An aeronaut's grapple and line, and the knife that cuts it.

name: Engine-arm
text: A Colonia engineer's piston arm: brass, iron, and a hammer where the hand should be.

name: Hammer
text: A long-hafted engineer's hammer, for posts and for what comes at them.

name: Bolt-thrower
text: A heavy crossbow-rifle of the Colonia works: two bolts, then the crank.

name: Scutum and gladius
text: A legionary's short sword behind a tall shield.

name: Short blades
text: Two legionary short swords, for the close work.

name: Pilum
text: A legionary's heavy spear: thrust, thrust, lunge.

name: Ward-staff
text: A grower's staff with a seed-pod head; the wards are planted with it.

name: Sickle
text: A Khemet reaping sickle on a short haft.

name: Seed-sling
text: A flared grower's gun that throws a cone of iron seed.

name: Astrolabe
text: A geometer's brass astrolabe, drawn like a bow: the figure is solved and loosed.

name: Glass blade
text: A straight blade of Baghdad glass; it does not dull.

name: Dividers
text: A pair of brass dividers held like knives; they measure the foe.

name: Wrapped fists
text: An ascetic's wrapped fists; the field is the weapon.

name: Staff
text: A plain ascetic's staff, worn smooth by a thousand nights.

name: Chakram
text: A thrown steel ring that comes back to the hand: six throws, then the gathering.

name: War fan
text: An examiner's iron war fan: closed it strikes, open it cuts.

name: Needles
text: Two long examiner's needles with ring pommels.

name: Brush-staff
text: An examiner's staff tipped with a great brush: the sentence is written on the foe.

name: Lance
text: A rider's lance, carried on foot: the charge is the lunge.

name: Horse-bow
text: A Kazan recurve, short enough to draw at a gallop.

name: Stock whip
text: A rider's stock whip: it reaches, it rakes, it pulls.

name: Lantern-staff
text: An archivist's staff with a brass lantern at its head; it lights what it strikes.

name: Pen-knives
text: Two scribe's pen-knives, sharper than they look.

name: The ledger
text: An iron-bound ledger the size of a shield, swung two-handed. Every blow is recorded.

name: Katana
text: An Edo blade: long, curved, drawn on the beat.

name: Naginata
text: An Edo pole-blade: reach and the sweeping lunge.

name: Longbow
text: A tall Edo bow; the full draw is the whole art.
